$comment: This app's depth spec, scored 0-3 per pillar against platform/depth.config.json. Fill in a plan for every pillar, even ones day one doesn't build. `npm run depth` prints the score and any warnings.

mastery.plan: Built: a streak raises the multiplier and the problem size, a miss drops both, so play sits at the edge of skill. Next: higher levels hide the cell digits so the whole lattice is mental.

open_loop.plan: Built: the end screen shows the level reached. Next: end each run on a teaser of the next locked topic grid (division).

progression.plan: Built: four levels within a run. Next: per-topic mastery tiers saved across sessions; mastering one topic opens the next topic's lock.

ownership.plan: A keyring: every topic mastered adds a lock you opened, styled by the method you used most.

consequence.plan: Built: a miss costs the streak and a level. Next: choose which method's lock to attempt for different point multipliers.

runway.plan: Built: problems are generated from the seed without limit; all 18 topic grids are built (99 methods), each driven by sliders. Next: per-topic games so every topic has replayable practice, not just demos.

habit.plan: A daily lock: one shared seed per day, the same problems for everyone.

stories.plan: Built: the six-method grid replays any problem as a 2×3 animation sized for the bottom half of a vertical video. Next: an export that records the grid for a given problem.

social.plan: On the friends host: a board for the daily lock, so friends race the same problems.
